Operation.description: An immutable ordered mutation retains its original source and already admitted first-party input owners until result transfer and explicit close.

Demand.description: One metadata event or bounded comparison fragment exposes its minimum work, exact aligned node/entry births and retained structural depth before movement. No mutation advance releases a final allocation: obsolete rotation roots remain in explicit close custody. Zero items, insufficient copy or one-short birth grants are inert. Insufficient depth refuses before mutation. Capacity and release remain distinct from logical key visits.
